sentences.text:
The first bail application has been filed by the applicant under Section 438 of the Code of Criminal Procedure, 1973 for grant of anticipatory bail to the applicant, who is apprehending his arrest in connection with Crime No.80 of 2021 registered at Police Station Mungawali District Ashoknagar (M.P.) for the offence punishable under Sections 420, 272 of IPC and Sections 51, 26(2)
(ii) of the Food Safety and Standards Act.
Learned counsel for the applicant requests to withdraw this application.

He further requests that a direction may be issued to the Investigation Officer to comply with the directions of the Supreme Court in cases of Arnesh Kumar Vs. State of Bihar (2014) 8 SCC 273,
Satender Kumar Antil Vs. Central Bureau of investigation (2022) 10 SCC 51 and Notification No.
Sunil Kumar vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 6 October, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/25772464/
1 A/5666/III-2-9/40 Pt-I F.No.15 dated 20/09/2023 issued by Hon'ble High Court of Madhya Pradesh, Jabalpur.
Request accepted.
